name: @blockle/mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Blockle L1 — wraps @blockle/agent-sdk so any MCP-capable agent can run a wallet, launch BLOCK-20 tokens, seed/trade the native AMM, buy/sell BLOCK over x402, and place + complete cross-chain swaps and permissionless listings on the non-custodial exchange. stdio + streamable-HTTP.
